name: Cold-start battery preparation
quote: Low temperatures can impact on the starting response. Re- peated, brief application of load on the battery causes battery temperature to rise, so more battery power is avail- able for starting the engine.

name: dust_interval
quote: Lubricate the chain more fre- quently if the motorcycle is ridden in wet, dusty or dirty conditions.

name: drive chain lubrication in wet conditions
quote: Lubricate the chain more fre- quently if the motorcycle is ridden in wet, dusty or dirty conditions. Lubricate the drive chain at regular intervals. min. 800 km

name: salt_wash
value: cold water immediately after every trip
quote: To remove road salt deposits, clean the vehicle and mounted parts, as applicable, with cold water immediately after every trip.
